page.layout: One text block of dictionary-style entries, Latin with Arabic and Hebrew-script words, in one column; in the right margin, beside the entries, short reference notes; page number at top right; gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: Assobailius ] قال السهيلي في الروض الانف [ Dixit p.167. Assobaili in libro AlRaudo'lOnoph, inquit, Ebn Chalecan in vita Pharazdaki. Eundem alibi ابو القاسم Abulkasem vocat.
Pharazdak ] الفرزدق cognomen Poëtæ celebris cui nomen همام بن غالب Hammam Ebn Galeb, vel juxta alios همم Homaim. obiit anno H. 110. annos natus fere centum.

شرح شواهد المغني ] Sharho Shawahed IlMogni, i. e. Explicatio testimoniorum quæ in Grammatica dicta مغني لبيب ابو محمد عبد الله بن هشام Abu Mohammed Abdollah Ebn Hashem, conscriptâ afferuntur, cujus author est Jalaloddinus, idem qui Commentarium in Alcorani partem, ut supra dictum, scriptit.
Almasudi ] المسعودي Author passim ab aliis laudatus, sed quem mihi videre nondum contigit. citatur in مروج الذهب liber ipsius خريدة العجائب.

AlTabarita ] ابو جعفر محمد بن جرير الطبري Abu Jaafar Mohammed Ebn Jarir AlTabari. Ille toties in Historica Saracenica laudatus. Natus anno H. 224. in ditione طبرستان Tabarastan, mortuus anno 310p.170. Ibid. [?]. historiæ suæ seriem perduxit ad annum 302 كان ذيل في دقلع وتاريخه اصح التواريخ واتبعها [?] Fidus fuit in allegationibus suis, estque historia ipsius historiarum verissima & certissima, inquit Ebn Challecan.AlIannab.&c.

page.notes: Scan is a single printed page. Right margin notes: "p.167.", "p.170. Ibid.", "AlIannab.&c." Arabic and Hebrew-script words are transcribed as far as legible; the Arabic in the line beginning كان and the number after "anno" (printed as an unclear 3-1-0) are doubtful. "Ille toties" is split across lines in print. Long s rendered as plain s throughout (printed "Affobailius", "Ifaac", "Hafhem", "Abulkafem", "Almafudi" read as Assobailius, Isaac, Hashem, Abulkasem, Almasudi). "Digitized by Google" credit at bottom right omitted. Catchword "Ebn" and signature "Ddd" at the foot.
